STOPPED before claim: the prerequisites named in this issue are not implemented on upstream/main 17a8c6e7608.

#1962 is still open. Its worker reports that the schema change stopped at the project-version overlap with #2026, which is already stacked on #2001.
#1965 is still open and has no implementation PR or claim recorded. The shared AC inverse kinematics solver is missing.
#1966 is still open and has no implementation PR or claim recorded. G93 timing and explicit section modes are missing.
The current post machine mirror still infers machine.rtcp from rotary tilt. The Mach4 post needs the explicit controller capability from #1962.

Completing the required indexed and simultaneous output here would require implementing those separate issues. This worker was instructed to work only #1968.
No claim, branch, code change, test run, or PR was made.

Expected files were assets/posts/mach4.cps, crates/app/src/posting.rs, crates/post/tests/mach4_post.rs, crates/app/tests/mach4_builtin.rs, and docs/decisions/1968-mach4-post.md, plus new conformance fixtures.
The file overlap check found #2029, #2026, #1753 and #1681 in posting.rs. No open PR changes mach4.cps or the proposed test and decision files.
